name: prefer-structural-fix
body: Prefer making the durable mutation structurally serial to retrying it. Removing DB access from the mutation path (evaluate-fix-ladder option c) removes DB contention only; it does NOT make the mutation race-free — the node-file read-modify-write (`edge_add`, src/node_cmd.rs:207) and the git index commit (`git::commit_files`, src/git.rs:587-645) still race — so it is a complement, never a standalone fix. The durable sequence (node-file RMW + DB opens + commit) must be serialized by construction: file-level serialization (option a, extended flock) on the direct path, and the single-writer session coordinator (option d) when a session is live. Bounded retry (option b) is never the primary fix. The session coordinator is a mandatory deliverable, justified by amortization + batching as well as by serialization, not by lock avoidance alone.
